description: The Texas Property Tax Replacement Plan ends all property taxes, franchise taxes, BPP taxes, and other state level taxes, freeing up Texas based businesses, replacing it with a Sales Tax on all non cost of living transactions. This article covers the amazing impact this will have on Texas businesses
title: Texas Property Tax Replacement - What it Means for Texas Businesses — Will Campbell For TexasWhat It Means for Texas Businesses — TPTRP Business Impact Analysis
